observations: Photo 0 shows a Canon DSLR body labeled “EOS 600D” with a lens attached labeled “EFS 18-55mm”.
Photo 0 also shows a second lens cap and a bag/strap in the background.
Photo 1 shows the camera from the back/side with the rear LCD and buttons visible; lens is still the EFS 18-55mm.
Photo 2 shows two camera bodies/lenses on the shelf: one clearly labeled “EOS 600D” and another labeled “EOS 700D” with a different lens (appears like a zoom lens).
The seller text mentions only “Canon EOS 600D”.

read_from: photo 1 camera rear/side shows Canon DSLR controls consistent with EOS 600D

claims.claim: UK used Canon EOS 600D Digital Camera very neat and sharp.
claims.evidence: Photos show a Canon EOS 600D with an 18-55mm lens, but do not show usage history (UK) or test results for sharpness/neatness.

risks.risk: The listing may be mixing items (photo 2 shows an additional Canon EOS 700D and another lens), so the buyer may not receive only the EOS 600D.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing exactly what is included for the sale: the EOS 600D body + which lens(es) + accessories, all laid out together and clearly labeled.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if only the EOS 600D kit with the visible EFS 18-55mm lens is included; treat extra items as not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Functionality is unknown remotely (shutter count, autofocus accuracy, LCD condition, buttons, and whether it takes photos).
risks.proof: Request a short video test: power on, menu navigation, autofocus on a nearby object, and a few sample shots displayed on the camera.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case for used DSLR kit: assume not fully verified (i.e., no guarantee of perfect working condition).

risks.risk: Lens condition is unknown (focus ring smoothness, fungus/haze, scratches on front element).
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of both lens front and rear elements under light (including any haze/fungus), plus a photo of the lens mount contacts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if lens may need cleaning/has minor wear; no premium for “very neat”.

risks.risk: Battery/accessories not confirmed (battery health, charger included, memory card included).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the exact included items: battery model, charger, USB cable (if any), and memory card (if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal essentials only (camera + lens), and treat charger/battery/memory as not guaranteed.

proof_requests: Confirm the exact bundle: does the buyer receive only EOS 600D or also the EOS 700D shown in photo 2? Send one clear “included items” photo.
Send a short video test: power on, autofocus test, and playback of 3 sample photos.
Send close-up photos of the lens front/rear elements (under light) and the lens mount contacts.
Show the exact accessories included (battery, charger, memory card if any) with photos.
response.reason: The photos identify a Canon EOS 600D with an 18-55mm lens, but the sale bundle and working/test condition are not provable from the images alone (photo 2 even shows another body). Proof is needed before a confident price.
